errors.text_span: two different parameters, α and ρ, respectively
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly labels the parameter in the right graph as 'ρ' instead of 'p', as shown in the figure.
The machine-generated description states the y-axis range is 28.0 to 28.5, but the figure shows the range is 28.0 to 28.6.
The machine-generated description states the x-axis in the right graph is marked at intervals of 0.05, but the figure shows intervals of 0.1.
The machine-generated description does not explain the purpose of the charts, which is to show the impact of parameters α and p on BLEU scores.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the BLEU score is highest at α = 0.5 and p = 0.15, which is a key insight from the figure.
The machine-generated description does not mention the tick intervals on the y-axis, which are 0.1.
